typical_topologies: Both lines are point-to-point/multi-drop CMOS push-pull-capable signaling

id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Multi-drop two-wire MIPI control bus: devices share SCLK and SDATA. SPMI is multi-master (<=4 masters) / multi-slave (<=16 slaves) with arbitration and Transfer Bus Ownership; RFFE is single-master / multi-slave (<=15 slaves).

supported_topologies.name: SPMI multi-master
supported_topologies.description: Up to 4 masters arbitrate for up to 16 slaves; slaves may raise a Request.

supported_topologies.name: RFFE single-master
supported_topologies.description: One master controls up to 15 RF front-end slaves (PA/LNA/switch/tuner/PMIC); no arbitration.

supported_topologies.name: Group addressing
supported_topologies.description: SPMI Group Sub-ID and RFFE GSID coordinate multiple slaves with one transaction.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Initiates transactions after winning arbitration; one of up to 4 masters; can Transfer Bus Ownership.
Responds to its 4-bit SLAVE_ID; may raise a Request; one of up to 16 slaves.
The single bus master; fully controls SCLK and timing.
RF front-end device addressed by 4-bit USID (and GSID); PA/LNA/switch/tuner/PMIC.

ultra_fast_mode_topology.description: Push-pull, unidirectional master-to-slaves only. No arbitration, no clock stretching, no ACK.
ultra_fast_mode_topology.use_case: LED controllers, GPO devices that need fast unidirectional writes.

fields.interconnect_role: SPMI is a shared system-power-management control bus; RFFE is the RF front-end control bus. Slaves are addressed by 4-bit ID; the master(s) configure, control, and monitor them, with SPMI power-state commands and RFFE triggers/interrupts.

ordering_guarantees.single_transaction: One transaction at a time on the shared bus.
ordering_guarantees.spmi_arbitration: Higher priority / lower MASTER_ID wins each round.
ordering_guarantees.rffe_trigger: Trigger-register values apply simultaneously on the Trigger event.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: SPMI/RFFE are command/register-oriented, not memory-mapped. Each slave exposes an 8-bit (or 16-bit Extended Long) register space addressed per command; there is no linear memory address space on the bus.

slave_classification.addressable_slave: Standard slave with hardwired or pin-selectable 7/10-bit address.
slave_classification.general_call_slave: Slave that recognizes the General Call address (0x00, R/W=0) in addition to its own.
slave_classification.ufm_slave: Ultra Fast-mode receive-only slave (LED controller, GPO).
